text:
Decision Memo: Year-One Vendor Selection
To: CFO
From: Priya, Procurement Owner
Recommendation: Approve Alpha for year one, pending CFO approval before signing.

Constraint: Year-one budget ceiling is $100,000, including setup. SSO is mandatory before production.

Evaluation:

| Vendor | Year-One Total | Budget | SSO | Other Requirements |
| Alpha | $92,000 [$72,000 + $20,000] | Within $100,000 | Available | Meets |
| Beta | $70,000 [$60,000 + $10,000] | Within $100,000 | Unavailable, no committed delivery date | Meets |

Analysis:
Alpha meets all constraints: $92,000 is within ceiling, required SSO is available, and other stated requirements are met.
Beta fails a mandatory constraint: although $70,000 is within ceiling and other stated requirements are met, required SSO is unavailable and has no committed delivery date, so it cannot proceed to production.

Conclusion: Select Alpha. It is the only vendor satisfying budget and mandatory SSO.

input.prompt:
Write a decision memo for the CFO choosing between the two vendors for year one. Evaluate against the stated constraints and make a specific recommendation.

SOURCE PACK (all facts are synthetic):
{
  "budget": "Year-one budget ceiling is $100,000, including setup.",
  "alpha": "$72,000 annual subscription plus $20,000 one-time setup. Required SSO is available.",
  "beta": "$60,000 annual subscription plus $10,000 setup. Required SSO is unavailable and has no committed delivery date.",
  "constraints": "SSO is mandatory before production. Both vendors meet the other stated requirements.",
  "owner": "Priya owns procurement. CFO approval is needed before signing."
}

Use only this source pack for factual claims. Produce the requested deliverable only. Maximum 300 whitespace-separated words, including titles and tables.
